nodes.label: Architecture Overview
nodes.rationale: Static SPA with no backend for core site. Design principles: conversion first, content separate from code, mobile first, simple and cheap to host, optional complexity (chatbot).

nodes.label: Analytics Strategy
nodes.rationale: Track only what supports the conversion goal: clicks on Call, WhatsApp, Book buttons and form submissions. Privacy-friendly tool. Single wrapper so provider can change later.

nodes.label: Design Principles
nodes.rationale: 1. Conversion first: every page leads visitor to call or book. 2. Content separate from code. 3. Mobile first. 4. Simple and cheap to host (static, no database). 5. Optional complexity (chatbot can be added/removed without breaking site).

nodes.label: Content-Code Separation Principle
nodes.rationale: Clinic owner can change text, services, FAQs, and reviews without touching components. All editable content in data files; all UI text in i18n JSON files.

nodes.label: Conversion-First Principle
nodes.rationale: Every page and component should lead the visitor to call or book an appointment. This is the single goal of the site.

nodes.label: Performance Strategy
nodes.rationale: Route-level code splitting with React.lazy. Chatbot lazy-loaded after idle or click. WebP images with explicit dimensions. Self-host fonts or font-display:swap. Target Lighthouse >90 on mobile.

nodes.label: Project Info (One Denta / Stale)
nodes.rationale: Contains generic placeholder values (One Denta, Dr. Dental) that are overridden by AGENTS.md and content.md which use Metro Dental BD / Dr. Mustak. Treated as stale by the progress log.

nodes.label: Content Rules
nodes.rationale: No invented medical claims, prices, or qualifications. Unknown items must be clearly marked placeholders. No copying from other clinic websites. Friendly, simple tone.

nodes.label: Application Layers
nodes.rationale: Pages compose sections only (no business logic). Sections read from data/ and i18n/ (no hardcoded facts). UI primitives are clinic-agnostic. Dependencies point downward only.

nodes.label: Service Page Template Pattern
nodes.rationale: All service pages use ONE shared template component fed by services.js. Adding a new service means adding one data entry, not a new page file.

nodes.label: Motion Rules
nodes.rationale: 200-300ms ease-out. Allowed: fade-up on scroll, hover transitions, accordion animation, menu slide-in. Not allowed: parallax, auto-playing carousels. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Coding Conventions
nodes.rationale: Functional components and hooks only; Tailwind utility classes with theme tokens; mobile-first; semantic HTML; accessible forms; lazy-loaded images.

nodes.label: Planned AI Chatbot
nodes.rationale: Chatbot must be a separate module so the site works without it. API keys must never be in front-end code. Answer from clinic documents first; web search as fallback. Must not diagnose or prescribe. Always show Call and WhatsApp options. Support English and Bangla.

nodes.label: Planned Chatbot Architecture
nodes.rationale: Server-side only for model calls (browser never sees API keys). Documents first, web search as fallback for general info. Small document set needs no vector DB. Safety rules in system prompt (no diagnosis/prescriptions). Always show contact options. Rate limiting and abuse control. Open decision: which model provider and host.

nodes.label: Booking Flow (Architecture)
nodes.rationale: Booking is a message not a confirmed appointment. Success message says clinic will confirm by reply. If real scheduling needed later, replace buildWhatsAppLink with booking API call; form component stays the same.

nodes.label: Tech Stack and Reasons
nodes.rationale: Vite chosen for fast dev server and small output. React for component reuse. React Router for multi-page feel. Tailwind for mobile-first utilities. react-helmet-async for per-page SEO. JSON-based i18n with no heavy library. WhatsApp link for booking (no backend, matches patient behavior). SEO note: client-rendered SPA is weaker for search; pre-rendering or Next.js migration suggested.

nodes.label: Security and Privacy
nodes.rationale: No secrets in repo or front end. Booking form sends no data to our servers; data goes only to WhatsApp when visitor chooses. Chatbot must not log personal/medical details. HTTPS only with security headers.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Booking Pattern
nodes.rationale: No backend for booking. Form opens wa.me link with prefilled text. Matches how patients already contact clinics. Booking is a message, not a confirmed appointment.

nodes.label: Project Summary (Metro Dental BD)
nodes.rationale: Multi-page mobile-first website for a dental clinic in Dhaka. Single goal: get visitors to call or book an appointment.

nodes.label: Bilingual i18n Pattern
nodes.rationale: Components call t(key). Helper looks up key in en.json or bn.json based on selected language. Falls back to English if Bangla key missing. Language saved in localStorage and sets lang attribute on html.
